purpose: Provide one machine-oriented restart entrypoint for the complete FPT Portal V2 website/Admin system after the 2026-09-23 Replace Resource consistency closeout, shared-Worker quiz-bridge composition repair, and the newly diagnosed Replace Resource CORS-preflight transport defect.

base.role: base business invariants, topology, preservation ledger, open gates, stop conditions and historical reconciliation

replaceResourceOverride.role: higher authority for Replace Resource canonical-to-prepared consistency plus the 2026-09-23 CORS-preflight defect and repair gate

quizBridgeCompositionOverride.role: higher authority for the shared fpt-portal-v2-worker top-level composition, quiz redeem-route preservation incident, guarded repair and owner-verified closeout state

fullSiteWorkflow.role: website-wide end-to-end execution map tying Admin/source writes to canonical state, prepared projections, public API/browser verification, rollback and preservation obligations; conflicting shared-worker entrypoint statements are superseded by the quiz bridge composition override

restartInstruction: Read the complete authority set above before diagnosing or changing Portal/Admin behaviour. Freshly prove live route/deployment/data-store ownership. Trace the complete write -> canonical -> prepared -> public API -> browser chain for student-visible changes. Preserve every shared Worker capability. Fail closed when projection parity, live ownership or rollback safety cannot be proved. Update this manifest and the applicable authority file in the same coherent change whenever the authority set, workflow topology or closed/open gate status changes.

latestClosedChange.name: Replace Resource canonical-to-prepared consistency
latestClosedChange.permanentInvariant: Admin Replace Resource success is valid only after both the canonical lesson resource and the current student-facing prepared lesson point to the verified replacement object; projection failure must fail closed.

latestOpenRepair.name: Replace Resource CORS preflight passthrough
latestOpenRepair.rootCause: The Replace Resource consistency wrapper treated OPTIONS preflight as a successful replacement response, then rejected it for missing lessonId/oldR2Key/newR2Key and returned HTTP 500, so the browser never sent the replacement POST.
latestOpenRepair.stateSafety: Read-only diagnostics proved canonical and prepared homework pointers remained on the original L3T2M24 object key; the failed browser attempt did not complete a replacement mutation.
latestOpenRepair.fix: Consistency processing is now gated to POST only; OPTIONS/non-POST requests pass through to the base handler. Dedicated regression coverage and a permanent preflight marker were added.
closureRequires: live GitHub Pages-origin OPTIONS preflight HTTP 200 with CORS
student-facing replacement is verified before final closeout

latestClosedRepair.name: Shared Worker quiz bridge composition restoration
latestClosedRepair.rootCause: The 2026-09-23 Admin deployment used index-admin-tools.js as the top-level Worker entrypoint and therefore replaced the previously active quiz bridge wrapper instead of composing it.
latestClosedRepair.permanentInvariant: The shared production Worker must retain the composed index-step10-quiz-bridge.js -> index-admin-tools.js chain; legacy Gate C remains verification-only and must not become a second production deploy path.

websiteWorkflowCoverage: lesson release import and prepared access publication
Replace Resource end-to-end transaction, CORS preflight and rollback
shared Worker deployment preservation and regression verification
nonNegotiableCompletionRule: No student-visible Admin/source mutation is complete merely because its canonical source write succeeded. Completion requires the applicable prepared projection publication/readback and, for incident closeout, live API/browser verification where available. Browser transport negotiation such as CORS OPTIONS is not an application mutation and must remain a successful pass-through prerequisite to the actual Admin POST.
nextChangeProtocol: verify browser preflight/transport for cross-origin Admin mutations
record evidence and update GCH authority
